title: session.rs sieve_delivery: FileInto non-newsgroup folder silently discards message when pool=None but no 452 returned
description: session.rs sieve_delivery line 997-1002: when a Sieve FileInto action names a non-newsgroup folder and pool is None, the message is silently dropped with only a warning log. Unlike the Keep action (which correctly returns SieveOutcome::TransientError when pool=None to trigger a 452 retry), FileInto falls through to SieveOutcome::Accepted. This means the sending MTA receives 250 OK but the message is permanently lost. The sending MTA cannot retry because it received a definitive success response. This is data loss.
